download.title: Download
download.description: A record of an image downloaded and saved by a user

id.description: Unique auto-generated ID for the download record

fileName.description: The name of the downloaded file

imageUrl.description: The base64 encoded data URL representation of the image

format.description: The image format used for download

size.description: The size resolution of the downloaded image

downloadedAt.description: The timestamp when the image was downloaded

userId.description: The UID of the user who downloaded the image

userName.description: The display name of the user

userAvatar.description: The profile photo URL of the user

ai_effect_original.title: AI Effect Original
ai_effect_original.description: Original image referenced by an image ID

src.description: The full source data URL or public storage URL

ai_effect_variant.title: AI Effect Variant
ai_effect_variant.description: Generated AI style variant of an original image

url.description: Storage URL or public URL of the variant

canvas_design.title: Canvas Design
canvas_design.description: A saved canvas design state containing settings, stickers, active frame, and user image

id.description: Unique id for the saved canvas design

userId.description: The firebase auth UID of the owner

name.description: The name of this saved canvas configuration slot

canvasData.description: Active design states such as stickers, image settings, color, frames

downloads/{downloadId}.description: A collection containing records of downloaded images

ai_effect_originals/{docId}.description: Original user images for AI processing

ai_effect_variants/{docId}.description: Generated stylistic AI variants of user images

canvas_designs/{designId}.description: Collection of saved canvas layout presets/projects per user
